# Does full-text availability move the mechanism ranking?

*Generated by `scripts/census_oa_bias.py` over 4,403,994 MeSH-indexed census articles, of which 936,347 (21.3%) carry a PMC identifier. Both arms use the SAME expert descriptors; only availability differs.*

The superseded version of this test compared 4,830 full-text records against 5,586 abstract-only ones, with the full-text side 98.7% open access. That is not a contrast. Here the split is 936,347 against 3,467,647.

| mechanism | with full text | without | OA rate | rank, OA | rank, non-OA | shift | median year |
|---|--:|--:|--:|--:|--:|--:|--:|
| `epigenetic` | 17,642 | 23,636 | 42.7% | 1 | 2 | +1 | 2015 |
| `nanoparticle` | 10,499 | 26,289 | 28.5% | 3 | 1 | -2 | 2020 |
| `immunotherapy` | 16,675 | 15,215 | 52.3% | 2 | 3 | +1 | 2022 |
| `car-t` | 7,264 | 8,094 | 47.3% | 4 | 4 | +0 | 2020 |
| `metabolic-targeting` | 3,948 | 4,861 | 44.8% | 5 | 5 | +0 | 2019 |
| `antibody-drug-conjugate` | 2,233 | 3,786 | 37.1% | 9 | 6 | **-3** | 2020 |
| `synthetic-lethality` | 2,589 | 2,848 | 47.6% | 6 | 7 | +1 | 2021 |
| `oncolytic-virus` | 2,570 | 2,436 | 51.3% | 7 | 8 | +1 | 2017 |
| `crispr` | 2,325 | 1,349 | 63.3% | 8 | 12 | **+4** | 2021 |
| `bispecific-antibody` | 1,524 | 1,938 | 44.0% | 10 | 10 | +0 | 2021 |
| `electrochemical-therapy` | 732 | 1,783 | 29.1% | 11 | 11 | +0 | 2015 |
| `sonodynamic` | 463 | 2,050 | 18.4% | 13 | 9 | **-4** | 2011 |
| `hifu` | 319 | 1,033 | 23.6% | 14 | 13 | -1 | 2018 |
| `phagocytosis-checkpoint` | 538 | 380 | 58.6% | 12 | 14 | +2 | 2022 |
| `microbiome` | 209 | 171 | 55.0% | 15 | 15 | +0 | 2023 |
| `mrna-vaccine` | 191 | 110 | 63.5% | 16 | 16 | +0 | 2024 |

**3 of 16 mechanisms shift 3 or more positions** between the two arms. OA rate runs 18.4% (`sonodynamic`) to 63.5% (`mrna-vaccine`), against 21.3% for the census as a whole.

**The confound is in the last column and is not controlled here.** PMC deposition rose steeply over the same period the newer mechanisms grew, so a mechanism with a recent median year has a high OA rate for reasons that have nothing to do with its subject. Read the OA column against the year column, not on its own: this measures an association, and attributing it to access rather than to publication era would need a design this page does not have.
